summary: Updated libxi package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XQueryDeviceState(). (CVE-2026-93541)
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XI2 class parsing via size_classes() and
copy_classes(). (CVE-2026-93542)
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XI2 class parser. (CVE-2026-93543)
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XI2 XIQueryDevice reply parsing.
(CVE-2026-93544)
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XListInputDevices(). (CVE-2026-93545)
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XListInputDevices() class parsing.
(CVE-2026-94281)
Out-of-bounds read in libXi's XI2 enter/leave/focus cookie conversion.
(CVE-2026-94282)
